answers.genPolicy:5c97941808809d9533ea6a15e4ac33:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | ... > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret) .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (Tickets , ('secret' : Secret , 'time' : CurrentTime)) , ...) > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Secret) if T == CurrentTime .
[B4] < UserX | 'knows' : Known , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knows' : (Known , Secret) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : nils , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (Owner , Owners) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owners' : (Owner , Owners , UserX) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : T) , Rest) , ...) >
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : nils , ...) > if CurrentTime - T > 2 .
